title: Succession Is Not Automatic
text: you know gamma doesn't automatically call your children if you study succession in the Bible for example no one who has family got the business no one Joshua was not related to Moses he cut the business Peter wasn't related to Jesus he got the business silas and timothy was related paul they got the business don't automatically think that has to go to the your kids or something oh dear oh my what have I done see you give it to them when you think you own it now it doesn't mean that God might not in some cases do that like in David and Solomon but their more cases where it didn't happen so don't walk around assuming that my siblings or my offspring should inherit this this God's bigger than your a private family take a deep breath now let your children to what God created them to do don't call them into the Ministry set them free to follow their purpose
